headline: Claude Code 2.1.326 and Antigravity CLI 1.5.10 change sandbox and approval defaults, so unattended jobs may need settings.

themes.title: Permission and sandbox holes closed
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.323 fixes a Bash `rm` check that could skip the dangerous-removal prompt ([2.1.323](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.323)), and 2.1.325 fixes a security issue in zstd response decoding ([2.1.325](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.325)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.7 closes a `PreToolUse` hook path that could skip admin review ([1.5.7](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.7)), 1.5.8 closes a sandbox proxy path bypass ([1.5.8](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.8)), and 1.5.9 stops custom MCP headers, such as API keys, from being forwarded to another host after a redirect ([1.5.9](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.9)).
themes.so_what: update Claude Code to 2.1.325 and Antigravity CLI to 1.5.9 or later.

themes.title: Unattended runs now need explicit trust
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.325 makes scheduled tasks and `/loop` ask before running a skill with `allowed-tools` or hooks, and sandboxed Bash asks by default ([2.1.325](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.325)). Codex 0.169.0 keeps project config and MCP servers off in untrusted directories for `codex exec` unless `--trust` is passed ([rust-v0.169.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.169.0)).
themes.so_what: add `Skill(name)`, the `sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed` setting, `--trust` and `accept-edits` to unattended jobs, or they may wait for approval or lose their config.

themes.title: New defaults change sandbox and behavior
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.326 stops sandboxed commands from writing to some sensitive home folders by default ([2.1.326](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.326)), and Antigravity CLI 1.5.10 blocks sandboxed reads of `~/.config` by default ([1.5.10](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.10)). Codex 0.167.2 sends tool updates incrementally by default on Google Cloud Vertex AI ([rust-v0.167.2](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.167.2)), and Antigravity CLI 1.5.7 makes Auto the default Agent Mode ([1.5.7](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.7)).
themes.so_what: re-check sandboxed jobs for blocked paths, and re-check any pinned Vertex setting or Agent Mode.

watch_next: Check that unattended Claude Code and Codex jobs still pass with the new prompts and `--trust` rule, and that sandboxed jobs are not blocked from home folders or `~/.config`. Kilo Code v7.8.28 and v7.8.30 are pre-releases, so the stable line stays at v7.8.27 until a stable tag appears.
